intro.title: A Place to Learn. A Place to Innovate.
intro.alt: Bright library reading hall with tall glass windows
paragraphs: Dr. Lankapalli Bullayya College of Engineering was established in 2010 in Visakhapatnam. The college is affiliated to Andhra University and approved by AICTE, New Delhi.
Our approach is simple: strong fundamentals, a lot of hands-on practice, and close contact with industry, so graduates can do the work from their first day.

pillars.text: To be a centre of engineering education that produces competent, ethical and innovative engineers.

pillars.title: Mission
pillars.text: Teach fundamentals well, learn by building, work with industry, and nurture research and entrepreneurship.

pillars.title: Philosophy
